remarks: * Open House Sat. Oct. 24th, 1-3pm*  This is the house you have been waiting for! Welcome to 9410 Kristina Circle. Beautiful property in the Clarence School District located in the Shadow Woods Community. Owners have taken very good care of this Essex built home. 3 roomy bedrooms, master suite has a very large updated bathroom and 2 walk-in closets. Bonus loft room could be converted into a 4th bedroom. Great kitchen with stainless steel appliances, island, pantry and roomy eating area leading to the spacious family room with a gas fireplace. 1st floor also boasts a dining room, office, laundry & spacious foyer. Entire house was upgraded to beautiful 6 panel wood doors and trim. Interior has been totally painted with neutral colors (2026). Some other features include a 3 season room overlooking the semi-private wooded yard with shed. Very nice roomy 2 car garage, full basement, glass block windows, loaded with shelves, sump pump w/water back-up, generator, 50 gallon hot water tank (2026),Lennox furnace has a bonus humidifier, 200 amp electrical, full attic with exhaust fan. Exterior has pristine landscaping, sprinklers, covered front porch and a rear patio.** Make an offer and celebrate the holidays in a new home!**
